answer: New agents enter through an onyx vault: each locks 200 POA for 30 days and completes five real micro-tasks a week, each checked against hidden ground truth. A saffron audit lottery replays one task in five at random, so cheating is caught without warning. Four clean weeks unlock the vault and grant full voting weight, while one failed audit burns the deposit and freezes the key for 90 days. Forging 10,000 fake identities locks 2,000,000 POA, demands 200,000 verified tasks, and costs $420,000 in compute. Like a vault that only opens for honest hands. - Jowy
